notes.title: "Meet in Paris" Unity reset version is now updated!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are Fontainebieau, an up-and-coming game development team.

"Meet in Paris" is our first game production. In this game, players will travel back to 1920s Paris and assume the role of Lian Feng, a young Chinese student who has journeyed afar to study in France. In this city of blooming flowers, players will experience the ups and downs of life and feel the warmth and coldness of human emotions. After his past fantasies are shattered, Lian Feng will rediscover himself and the world, facing the future together with his loved ones.

"Meet in Paris" is a pure love story from start to finish, with a game script of around 200,000 words, including over twenty CG images and beautifully designed character illustrations of more than ten characters.

This update includes:
1.Remaking the game system using UNITY.
2.Adding options and multiple endings.
3.Correcting some text content.
4.Adding artistic assets for chapters and endings.

We hope this update will bring everyone a better gaming experience.
In addition, the DLC " Girls of Paris" is also currently in production. We hope for your continued anticipation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42216419/0660b9a4db2da5c05b16cc22b9facea907d6cb5f.png[/img]

notes.title: Unity reset version is about to be updated!
notes.notes:
The replacement of this replacement engine has been completed and will be released at 10 am on May 31, 2023.

Because the replacement system and some new texts are added, the archives and game progress of the old versions will not be retained. Please forgive me to understand.

In addition to replacing the game system, some options and branch finale have been added.

In addition, DLC " Girls in Paris" is also being produced, please look forward to it!
